item.title: 英语学习 - The Strategy of Protest and Revolution 1: Basic Elements (04/05/2020) - 2026-05-02 05:44
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：50 分钟 (2482 字符)

阅读解析 (意群划分) 翻译参考 核心词汇 表达讲解
Hi, / and welcome / to Strategy Stuff. 嗨，欢迎来到 Strategy Stuff。 Strategy: 策略/战略 标准的欢迎语结构。Stuff 在这里指“东西/频道内容”。
This is / a video series / on / The Strategy of Protest and Revolution, / where we’ll look at / how successful revolutionary and protest movements / have strategized / to achieve their political goals. 这是一个关于抗议和革命策略的视频系列，我们将探讨成功的革命和抗议运动是如何制定策略来实现其政治目标的。 Protest: 抗议
Revolution: 革命
Movement: 运动
Strategize: 制定战略		 where 引导定语从句修饰 series；how 引导宾语从句说明 look at 的内容。
First: / How do activists / turn / public discontent / into / a political movement? 第一：活动家们如何将公众的不满转化为政治运动？ Activist: 积极分子/活动家
Discontent: 不满		 turn A into B：将 A 转化为 B，是描述变化的核心短语。
Second: / How do movements / plan their action out / to achieve / their political goals? 第二：运动如何规划其行动以实现其政治目标？ Plan out: 详细计划/规划
Achieve: 实现		 plan out 强调计划的完整性和细节。
And third, / how have successful strategies / changed / with time? 第三，成功的策略是如何随时间变化的？ With time: 随着时间推移 使用现在完成时 have changed 表示从过去到现在持续的变化过程。
Over this series, / we’ll answer these questions / by looking at / various historical movements. 在这个系列中，我们将通过观察各种历史运动来回答这些问题。 Various: 各种各样的
Historical: 历史的		 by doing sth：通过某种手段或方式。
But / before we do that, / let’s first structure our thinking / by examining / the basic elements / within a strategy / of protest and revolution. 但在那之前，让我们先通过研究抗议和革命策略中的基本要素来构建我们的思路。 Structure: 构建/组织
Examine: 审查/研究
Element: 要素		 structure our thinking：使思维条理化。
Definitions 定义 Definition: 定义 小标题。
Protests and revolutions / are both / what sociologists call / social movements. 抗议和革命都是社会学家所称的社会运动。 Sociologist: 社会学家 what sociologists call：名词性从句，作表语。
The key characteristic / they share / is collective action, / where / ordinary people / band together / to push political demands / against establishment interests, / which are / usually backed by state power. 它们共有的关键特征是集体行动，即普通人团结起来，针对通常由国家权力支持的既得利益集团提出政治诉求。 Characteristic: 特征
Collective: 集体的
Band together: 团结/结合
Establishment: 既得利益阶层/权势集团
Backed by: 由...支持		 Establishment 指现存的社会统治结构或权力机构。
Members of the establishment / may lead a movement, / but / it is ordinary people / who ultimately provide / the driving force, / and that’s what differentiates / social movements / from coups, / which are / completely driven by / members of the establishment. 既得利益集团的成员可能会领导一场运动，但最终提供动力的是普通民众，这就是社会运动与政变的区别，政变完全是由既得利益集团成员驱动的。 Ultimately: 最终
Driving force: 驱动力
Differentiate: 区分
Coup: 政变 (发音 /kuː/)		 it is... who...：强调句型。differentiate A from B：区分 A 和 B。
There are many ways / to explain / why a social movement succeeds, / but / since this is a strategy channel, / we’ll focus on / the process / of protest and revolution, / looking at / how movements took / what they had / and turned it into victory. 有很多方法可以解释为什么社会运动会成功，但既然这是一个策略频道，我们将专注于抗议和革命的过程，看看运动是如何利用现有的资源并将其转化为胜利的。 Focus on: 专注于
Process: 过程
Victory: 胜利		 since 在这里引导原因状语从句，意为“既然/因为”。
At the most basic level, / the social movement process / takes the input / of public participation / and converts it / into the output / of political power. 在最基本的层面上，社会运动过程获取公众参与的投入，并将其转化为政治权力的产出。 Participation: 参与
Convert: 转化
Input/Output: 输入/输出		 convert A into B：将 A 转化/变换为 B。
The establishment / looks at that power / and has two options: / it can decide / that it’s not possible / or worth it / to match that power, / leading to / negotiation and compromise; / or it can increase / its own power / to outmatch the movement, / leading to suppression / or, in the event of / complete failure, / a revolution. 既得利益集团审视这种权力并有两种选择：它可以决定不可能或不值得去抗衡这种权力，从而导致谈判和妥协；或者它可以增加自己的力量来压倒运动，从而导致镇压，或者在完全失败的情况下，导致革命。 Worth it: 值得
Match: 抗衡/匹配
Negotiation: 谈判
Compromise: 妥协
Outmatch: 胜过/压倒
Suppression: 镇压		 leading to：分词结构作结果状语。in the event of：万一/如果发生某事。
Either way, / the more power / a movement has, / the higher / its chances of success. 无论哪种方式，运动拥有的权力越多，成功的机会就越高。 Either way: 无论如何
Chance: 机会		 the more..., the higher...：越……，就越……（比较级句型）。
So / how can a movement / increase its power? / Looking again / at the social movement process, / we see two ways / to do so: / we either increase / the amount of input, / or we increase / the rate of conversion / into output. 那么，运动如何增加其权力呢？再次观察社会运动的过程，我们看到两种方法：要么增加投入量，要么提高转化为产出的效率。 Rate: 速率/比例
Conversion: 转化		 either... or...：要么……要么……（两者选其一）。
In practical terms, / this means / we either get / more of the public / to participate, / or we get / our existing participants / to contribute / more political power. 从实际角度来看，这意味着我们要么让更多的公众参与，要么让现有的参与者贡献更多的政治力量。 Practical terms: 实际情况/实际而言
Existing: 现有的
Contribute: 贡献		 get someone to do something：使/让某人做某事。
These two / fundamental options / form the skeleton / of a social movement / grand strategy. 这两个基本选项构成了社会运动大战略的骨架。 Fundamental: 基本的/根本的
Skeleton: 骨架/纲要
Grand strategy: 大战略		 form the skeleton of：构成……的框架/基础。
Grand Strategy: / Issues vs Organization 大战略：议题 vs 组织 Issue: 议题/问题
Organization: 组织		 vs: 经常用于对比两个对立或相关的概念。
